description: This PHP source file defines the EmailFromValidator class, which specializes in validating 'From' email addresses and related fields for email handling within the SuiteCRM project. It includes constants for error codes, validation methods for email and name fields, and error message management.

classes.name: EmailFromValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating and handling 'From' address and related information in email messages, ensuring correctness and consistency of email headers before sending.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the email's 'From' and related fields, attempting to correct issues if possible, and returns whether the validation succeeded.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email object to be validated.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the stored Email object, throwing an exception if not set or of wrong type.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds a validation error code to the error list, ensuring it's an integer and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: addErrors
methods.description: Merges a list of errors into the internal error list, maintaining uniqueness.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns and clears the current list of errors.

methods.name: getErrorsAsText
methods.description: Provides human-readable messages and error codes for current errors.

methods.name: getErrorAsText
methods.description: Converts an error code into a localized error message.

methods.name: getErrorTextLabel
methods.description: Maps an error code to its corresponding message label key.

methods.name: hasErrors
methods.description: Checks if there are any validation errors present.

methods.name: isValidEmailAddress
methods.description: Checks if a given email address string is valid.

methods.name: isValidNonEmailAddress
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid non-email address, used for name validation.

methods.name: isValidFromAddress
methods.description: Validates if a 'From' address string is a valid email.

methods.name: isValidFromName
methods.description: Validates if a 'From' name string is valid.

methods.name: isValidFromAddrName
methods.description: Validates that the 'from_addr_name' string is correctly formatted and consistent, including regex matching and cross-field validation with the Email object.
